description: Stages of run_pipeline.py in the Retail Analytics Lakehouse, in order, with the data layers each stage reads and writes (folders under data/, partitioned by batch_date). A stage can only run when the layers it reads exist for the batch date.

stages.name: Incremental ingestion and Bronze validation
stages.notes: Detects new or changed files with the manifest, runs file and record validation, then loads Bronze with an explicit schema in FAILFAST mode. A malformed CSV row or a value of the wrong type stops the stage.

stages.name: Record-level CDC
stages.notes: Compares today's Bronze with the previous batch to find inserted, updated and deleted records.

stages.name: Incremental Silver
stages.notes: Applies CDC changes to the cleaned Silver tables.

stages.name: SCD Type 2
stages.notes: Maintains history for customers and products dimensions.

stages.name: Fact enrichment
stages.notes: Joins order facts to the dimension versions valid at order time.

stages.name: Gold data quality
stages.notes: Reconciliation and integrity checks; writes data/gold_quality_audit.

rerun: python run_pipeline.py --batch-date <date> [--start-from <module>]. --start-from skips every earlier stage, so it is only safe when those stages already wrote their output for the same batch date.
